title: Stateful applications: database inside or outside the cluster?

videos.script: Everything the shop has run so far could be thrown away and started again. A database cannot. {{cattle}} It needs the same disk every time it starts, a name its clients can find, a clean shutdown, and a copy kept somewhere else. {{needs}} Kubernetes has an object for the first two, the StatefulSet, and the rest is your job. {{statefulset}} You will run PostgreSQL in the cluster, delete its pod and find the data still there, take a backup with a Job, and read how it shut down. {{plan}} Then the harder question, which no manifest answers: should the database be in the cluster at all? {{question}}
